safe_claims.public_wording: Euloge Mabiala is a developer whose inspected work spans software engineering, data and automation.

His current work-study context at Soufflet Malt involves Industry 4.0 deployment, industrial data, functional testing, KPI follow-up and user adoption.

ELOS is a Next.js/React/TypeScript learning application with document-extraction adapters, evidence-based competency records and automated test suites present.

Classeur Numérique Intelligent is a local-first application using IndexedDB storage, legacy-data migration and recovery-oriented tests with CI workflows.
Maintenance is a contextual maintenance-management application, but the repository should be presented as inactive rather than current work.

The inspected public project portfolio provides direct evidence of repeated TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, application-level SQL and automated-testing practice, with applied Supabase and CI/CD configuration and practiced Docker usage.
His GitHub account contained 61 public repositories at the audit date; this inventory includes forks and empty repositories and must not be presented as 61 original completed projects.
ECV is a TypeScript-based encrypted code-vault project with CLI, policy and maintenance modules and automated test suites present.
limitations: Tests not executed in the GitHub export audit
